versions.changelog:
Initial release of Mercadona API skill.

- Provides endpoints for product search, nutritional info, categories, ticket scanning, and report issues.
- Features fuzzy product search with support for Spanish queries and brand names.
- Supports nutritional calculations per portion using standardized fields.
- Includes AI-powered receipt uploads for extracting and analyzing shopping nutritional data.
- No authentication required; usage is open within reasonable limits.
- Detailed data model, search examples, and agent usage tips provided in documentation.
